title: Media & Podcasts
metaDescription: Podcast and media production in Olympia, Lacey, and Tacoma. Recording, editing, and content support for comedians and brands.
summary: Audio and video production for comedians and brands who want broadcast-ready podcasts and media in the South Sound.
whatYouGet: Recording setup, engineering, and production support.
Video capture and editing for clips and episodes.
Distribution guidance for podcast and social channels.
idealFor: Comedians launching or leveling up a podcast.
process: Define the show format, guests, and release cadence.
Capture audio/video in-studio or on location.
Deliver edited episodes and highlight assets.
pricing: Pricing depends on episode length and production needs. Request a quote for a tailored package.

faqs.q: Do you record podcasts in Olympia or Tacoma?
faqs.a: Yes. We support recording across Olympia, Lacey, Tacoma, and the South Sound with mobile or studio setups.

faqs.q: Can you handle editing and highlight clips?
faqs.a: We provide full post-production, including audio polish, video edits, and social-ready clips.

faqs.q: Do you help with podcast distribution?
faqs.a: We can guide platform setup and recommend best practices for consistent releases.

faqs.q: How many episodes can we book at once?
faqs.a: We offer single-episode sessions and multi-episode production blocks depending on your schedule.
